LanguageData.AgriStats_SettingBestGrower: Count harvests at my best grower's yield
LanguageData.AgriStats_SettingBestGrowerDesc: On: harvests are counted at the plant harvest yield of your best colonist who can grow. Off: a flat 100%.
LanguageData.AgriStats_SettingShowNonFood: List zones growing things that aren't food
LanguageData.AgriStats_SettingShowNonFoodDesc: Cotton, smokeleaf, healroot, trees and the like. They are never counted as food.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ViewNowDesc: Production at today's temperature, light and soil.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ViewYearDesc: Production averaged over a whole year, using this map's seasons for outdoor fields. Indoor rooms are assumed to stay at today's temperature.
LanguageData.AgriStats_HarvesterBest: Harvests counted at {0}'s plant harvest yield ({1}). Best-case figures: sowing and harvesting time and blight are not counted.
LanguageData.AgriStats_HarvesterFlat: Harvests counted at {0} yield. Best-case figures: sowing and harvesting time and blight are not counted.
LanguageData.AgriStats_NoFarms: No growing zones or plant growers on this map.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColZoneDesc: The growing zone, or all plant growers of one kind growing the same crop. Click a row to jump to it.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColCropDesc: What the zone is set to grow.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColFertilityDesc: Average soil fertility of the cells.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColGrowthDesc: Average growth of the crop already planted.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColNutritionDesc: Nutrition produced per day, in the same unit pawns eat. A vanilla adult needs about 1.6 a day.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColRawDesc: How many of your people this feeds if they eat it raw.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColCookedDesc: How many of your people this feeds cooked into simple meals, which turn a little raw food into a full meal.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColPasteDesc: How many of your people this feeds through a nutrient paste dispenser, the most food-efficient way to eat.
LanguageData.AgriStats_ColNotesDesc: Anything stopping the crop from growing well.
LanguageData.AgriStats_AnimalLine: Animal feed: {0} nutrition/day. {1} animals that eat it need {2}/day.
LanguageData.AgriStats_AnimalLineNone: Animal feed: {0} nutrition/day. No colony animals that eat it.
